question: What is the area of the segment formed by a chord in a circle of radius 10 cm, if the angle subtended at the center is 90°?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a segment subtending 90° at the center, we can directly use the formula: Area = r² × (π/4 − 1/2)

⇒ Area = 10² × (π/4 − 1/2)

⇒ Area = 100 × (π/4 − 1/2)

⇒ Area = 25π − 50 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 25π − 50 cm².**
